subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway and ContextEngine plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The session-key bug is mechanical, but the permanent HTTP endpoints, operator/admin method scopes, and optional plugin hooks create a public control contract that needs maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Approve after session fix
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, branch refresh, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read-only control
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own an explicit maintenance mutation surface.

options.title: Defer to plugin/private surfaces
options.body: Pause or close the core PR if context-engine maintenance control should stay outside OpenClaw core until a broader Gateway control design exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after session fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, branch refresh, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has adjacent context-engine ownership and Gateway method-scope history, making him the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
